title: Introducing Spyglass: Your New Productivity Partner
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, a powerful new tool designed to enhance your productivity and streamline your workflow.

title: Enhanced File Management & Display
summary: Take full command of your content with intuitive new tools that provide seamless control over how you embed, manage, and display all your files directly within the editor.

title: Explore Our Journey: The Public Roadmap
summary: Stay informed about our latest achievements and upcoming innovations with our brand-new, transparent public roadmap.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: We've rolled out significant improvements to our checkboxes, making them bigger, easier to click, more visually appealing, and effortlessly draggable to empower your productivity.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience effortless teamwork with our newly refined editor collaboration features, designed to make real-time co-editing smoother and more intuitive than ever.

title: Seamless Shared Item Access and Collaboration
summary: Now you can effortlessly find and collaborate on shared ideas and projects, with improved visibility and streamlined access to all relevant items across your network.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons to support a multitude of international languages, creating a more inclusive and global experience for everyone.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with full transparency and the opportunity to directly contribute to its evolution.

title: Dynamic Graph Insights
summary: Elevate your knowledge exploration and collaboration with advanced filtering by tags and time, alongside seamless sharing options, all within a revitalized Constellation view.

title: Enhanced Search & Curated Collections
summary: Effortlessly discover and organize your knowledge with powerful new filters, flexible sorting options, and the ability to save your custom views as personalized collections.

title: Flexible Content Layouts
summary: Organize your thoughts more naturally with dynamic new options for displaying and interacting with linked content directly within your notes.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting & Premium Features
summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons, offering you the choice to either self-host the platform for ultimate control or enjoy premium features with our new cloud-hosted plans.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Expanded Themes
summary: Customize your interface with a wider array of beautifully polished themes designed to suit every preference and elevate your visual experience.

title: Accurate Greetings, Day or Night
summary: We're ensuring your in-app greetings always match the exact time of day for a truly personalized and precise welcome.

title: Effortless Tag & List Management
summary: Gain valuable time back by effortlessly managing multiple tagged items directly from your lists with new quick actions, including deleting and untagging.

title: Connect with More Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring in and interact with information from diverse sources like websites, videos, and text files, empowering you to gather insights from anywhere.
